items.raw_excerpt: If you're looking for a job in Norway, sending out applications will rarely be enough – networking is the name of the game.

items.raw_excerpt: It's not Friday 13th that is considered a day of bad luck in Spain but Tuesday 13th. Read on to find out why as well as some of the strangest Spanish superstitions.

items.raw_excerpt: Some of Italy’s foreign residents may still be wearing t-shirts, but Italians are preparing for the most stressful style-related event of the year: the summer-to-autumn wardrobe switch. Silvia Marchetti explains what it’s all about.
